_about: Font packages written for pdfLaTeX. 'remove' entries are removed automatically by `tex-a11y fix` because LuaLaTeX does not need them. 'suggest' entries are only reported: the suggestion is the usual OpenType replacement loaded with fontspec/unicode-math, as in the template.

remove.fontenc: LuaLaTeX uses the TU encoding; fontenc (for example T1) would load older Type 1 fonts.
remove.lmodern: LuaLaTeX already uses Latin Modern (OpenType) by default.

suggest.mathdesign: Choose an OpenType text and math font pair with fontspec/unicode-math.
suggest.cmbright: Choose an OpenType text and math font pair with fontspec/unicode-math.
suggest.concmath: Choose an OpenType text and math font pair with fontspec/unicode-math.
